question: Which two pop icons are about to go head to head at the VMAs?
story: Madonna just landed eleven VMA nominations, and Taylor Swift is standing directly in her way in eight of them. According to Variety and the Hollywood Reporter, Madonna leads the twenty twenty six MTV Video Music Awards with eleven nods, including Video of the Year, Artist of the Year, and Song of the Year for her Sabrina Carpenter collaboration, Bring Your Love. Swift is right behind her with nine. And when you line the two lists up, they overlap in eight categories. Video of the Year. Artist of the Year. Direction. Cinematography. Editing. Choreography. Visual effects. Art direction. Here is the stat that makes this bigger than one night. Rolling Stone reports that if Madonna swept every category she is nominated in, she would tie Beyonce and Taylor Swift for the most VMA wins in history. So Taylor is nominated against the record, and she is also holding it. September twenty seventh, on CBS.
